Class OffscreenButtons

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.api.OffscreenButtons
public final class OffscreenButtons extends Object
Builds buttons and adds pop-out actions without imposing an appearance or GUI framework. 
// Keep an existing GuiButton's drawing, subclass and normal action:
OffscreenButtons.popOut(myButton, MyScreen::new);

// Or create a vanilla-looking button with its action already connected:
var button = OffscreenButtons.button("Open")
        .opens(MyScreen::new)
        .tooltip("Open in a separate window")
        .build(42, x, y, 100, 20);

// A framework with its own button class can use just the action:
Runnable click = OffscreenButtons.popOut(MyScreen::new);

Call on Minecraft's client thread. Screen suppliers create fresh client-only screens on each click, not at button construction. Server containers need their synchronized factory instead. All optional styling, images, framework adaptation and custom painting live in this helper and its nested types. Creating ordinary buttons needs neither a native window nor ModularUI. Registering a button does not add it to a GUI's layout automatically.

  • Method Details

    • popOut

      public static <B extends net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiButton> B popOut(B button, Supplier<?> screen)
      Appends a pop-out action to an existing vanilla button without changing any of its visuals or subclass. The callback runs after the screen's normal button action. Calling again replaces this helper's previous attachment rather than adding another window per click. The caller must add the button to its screen normally.
      Type Parameters:
      B - existing GuiButton subclass
      Parameters:
      button - button whose enabled, visible and native hit-testing behavior is retained
      screen - fresh local screen supplier, invoked once per accepted click
      Returns:
      the exact supplied button for fluent layout code
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if either argument is null

    • popOut

      public static Runnable popOut(String title, Consumer<Window> install, Consumer<Runnable> afterInstall)
      Creates a pop-out action for a framework that installs its screen after a deferred client callback.

      The installer may enqueue its own screen setup. The supplied scheduler must execute the completion callback exactly once on the client thread, after that setup has completed. A failed or empty installation closes only the newly created window. Do not use a background executor: native window operations require the client context. For synchronous factories, use the simpler two-argument overload.

      Parameters:
      title - native desktop title
      install - framework installer receiving its exact new window
      afterInstall - client scheduler that runs its argument after the installer's deferred setup
      Returns:
      reusable pop-out action, allocating one owned window per invocation
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if an argument is null

    • popOutWindow

      public static Runnable popOutWindow(Supplier<Window> factory, Consumer<Window> install, Consumer<Runnable> afterInstall)
      Creates a pop-out with caller-selected native presentation, such as transparent custom chrome. The factory runs once per click on the client thread. Offscreen owns cleanup if installation fails; the deferred check still closes windows whose screen was never installed.
      Parameters:
      factory - creates a fresh, open window for this click
      install - installs the screen in that exact window
      afterInstall - schedules the readiness check after deferred screen setup
      Returns:
      reusable button action
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if a callback or its new window is null
